The Lodges

Choose your forest

Pench, Madhya Pradesh

Mahua Vann

3 km to Turia Safari Gate

Mud-plastered cottages under old canopy in Mowgli country. Verandas open into birdsong; the safari jeep idles before first light.

Explore Mahua Vann
Tadoba, Maharashtra

Mahua Tola

6 km to Kolara Gate · 7.5 acres on a seasonal river

Ethnic-inspired architecture along a riverbed, in a forest where the tigers are famously bold and the afternoons famously slow.

Explore Mahua Tola
